notes: Independence check vs S.N. 100 IKEA UK (c100.json), S.N. 117/156 IKEA DE (c117.json) and S.N. 155 IKEA France (c155.json): confirmed GENUINELY SEPARATE -- the 4th independent country catalogue on IKEA's global platform. Verified via locale path https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/ (direct fetch HTTP 200, no blocking, no ClaudeBot-specific robots.txt disallow found on ikea.com); embedded page settings confirm marketCode=en-AE, siteFolder=ae/en, region=ME, ecomMarket=true (a genuine live UAE ecommerce storefront, not a redirect/stub). Queried the ae/en market via the same sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/ae/en/search PRIMARY_AREA API used for UK/DE/FR, against the confirmed-global 58-leaf-category ID scheme shared across all four markets. Cross-checked AE qty against all three siblings on every one of the 58 shared category IDs: AE matched UK on only 8/58, DE on 5/58, FR on 5/58, and there was NOT ONE category where all four markets reported an identical qty simultaneously -- confirming AE runs its own distinct per-market inventory/catalog exactly per the established IKEA per-country pattern (occasional pairwise qty coincidences are expected noise across catalogs this size, not evidence of a shared listing). Methodology followed the IKEA France (S.N. 155) worker lesson explicitly flagged for this task: used metadata.itemsPerType.PRODUCT (not the raw metadata.max field, which can include a non-product breakout card) as qty, cross-checked against the unique product itemNoGlobal count from a full window=999 fetch (always matched), then boundary-tested at offset=qty-1 (returned the final product) and offset=qty (returned an empty PRIMARY_AREA result set) for all 57 categories the API accepted -- all passed cleanly, and a same-window refetch reproduced an identical qty every time (Session-Id pinned per run). ONE category (24831, Art Cards) returned HTTP 404 'Unknown category key: 24831' from the sik.search API on the ae/en market specifically (all other 57 IDs succeeded) even though the category IS live on the AE site (page title 'Wall Art Cards for Home Decor Online in UAE - IKEA', HTTP 200); qty=24 for this one row was instead sourced from the category page's own embedded SSR search-result state (metadata start=0/end=24/max=24/itemsPerType.PRODUCT=24, i.e. the page's own first load already reached the exhaustion boundary with no further pages), reproduced identically across two independent fetches. Category naming: AE storefront is English (siteFolder ae/en) but its own per-category display names sometimes diverge from the UK/DE/FR-derived labels used in the sibling rows on the SAME shared numeric category ID -- each row here uses the AE site's own live nav label as source of truth (not copied from a sibling), e.g. 20502 is 'Work Lamps' on AE vs 'Desk Lamps' on UK; 18751 is 'Pendants' on AE vs 'Pendant Lights' on UK; 700512 is 'Portable Lamps' on AE (matching UK's own URL slug portable-lamps-700512 despite UK's row label reading 'Rechargeable Lamps'); 10788 is 'Ready to Hang Art' on AE vs 'Framed Pictures & Picture Sets'/canvas-wall-art on UK/FR (same decorative-framed-wall-art scope either way); 16308 is 'Bowls & Dishes' on AE vs 'Decorative Bowls & Dishes' on UK/FR; 18870 is 'Juice Glasses' on AE vs 'Wine & Champagne Glasses' on UK/FR (spot-checked, still decorative/functional drinking glassware, in scope either way); 22663 is 'Speciality Glassware' on AE vs 'Bar & Cocktail Glasses'/'Cocktail Glasses' on UK/FR (still glassware, in scope). All naming divergences are cosmetic per-market curation choices on the same numeric category ID and do not change scope inclusion under the standing INCLUDE rules (Lighting, Mirrors, Glassware all explicitly in scope regardless of label). Rule 0.2 finding NOT incorporated into this row set (flagged for project awareness rather than acted on unilaterally): a deeper nav sweep of the AE mega-menu surfaced additional lighting-by-room/furniture-integration nodes that exist on IKEA's shared global platform under the same li001 Lighting hub -- e.g. Cabinet Lighting (700821), Wardrobe Lighting (16283), Bookcase Lighting (16281), Kitchen Lighting hub 16282 (with Worktop/Kitchen Cabinet/Drawer lighting subs), Track Lighting (25209), Ceiling Spotlights (18753), Wall Spotlights (20505), Bathroom Cabinet Lighting (55010), Pathway Lighting (700620), Outdoor Light Chains (700619) -- none of which appear in the standing confirmed-global 58-category scheme used by S.N. 100/117/155 for this same company. Since these node IDs sit on the same shared global category tree, they almost certainly exist identically on UK/DE/FR too, i.e. this looks like a scheme-wide gap affecting all four IKEA rows already merged, not something AE-specific -- flagging here rather than unilaterally expanding only the AE row, which would make it non-comparable with its three already-merged siblings without a corresponding fix there; recommend a follow-up pass across all four IKEA rows together if the project wants this closed. Excluded per standing rules and confirmed present on the AE nav during the sweep: light bulbs (Standard/Smart/Decorative LED light bulbs), smart light switches & remote controls (wiring/hardware), light filtering curtains (textile), furniture-specific accessory lighting parts (Lighting for BESTA/PLATSA/LASTARE/METOD/ENHET -- functional fitted parts for specific furniture systems, not standalone decor fixtures, same basis as the lamp-shade/base hardware exclusion applied on UK/DE/FR). Rule 0.6 overlap (same as UK/DE/FR): Mirrors presents both a shape/type cross-cut and a room/use cross-cut as separate category IDs; Lighting mixes a fixture-type tree with a room/use tree at the same level; both trees emitted in full on both branches, consistent with sibling rows. Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered.
